I printed what you sent. Here's how it came out:
knob:
- 7.40 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.
socket_coupon:
- 7.40 mm pocket: I can't tell you how that one came out.

Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged, and I'll print it again from what you send.

I’ll keep the design unchanged because there isn’t a fit result to base an adjustment on. The pocket is 8.30 mm across flats; the retaining lips narrow the opening locally to 7.40 mm and are intended to flex outward as the nut presses in.

The retaining lips project inward to a local 7.40 mm opening; they flex outward during insertion. One printed knob plus one ISO 4032 M5 nut forms the finished assembly. Coupon is optional and sacrificial.","params":{"nut_af":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog","note":"ISO 4032 M5 across flats"},"nut_h":{"value":4.7,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"socket_af_clearance":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Total across-flats clearance"},"bolt_d_clearance":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"knob_d":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"asked"},"height":{"value":10,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"body_radius":{"value":13,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lobe_radius":{"value":3.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lobe_count":{"value":8,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_t":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"nut_axial_clearance":{"value":0.25,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_root_z":{"value":1.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_width":{"value":2.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_t":{"value":0.95,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_side_gap":{"value":0.65,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_back_gap":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_count":{"value":3,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_projection":{"value":0.45,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_vertical_land":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_top_z":{"value":9.7,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lip_union_overlap":{"value":0.05,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"cut_overrun":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    h=p.height
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.body_radius).extrude(h)
    ring=p.knob_d/2-p.lobe_radius
    for i in range(int(p.lobe_count)):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.lobe_count
        body=body.union(cq.Workplane('XY').center(ring*math.cos(a),ring*math.sin(a)).circle(p.lobe_radius).extrude(h))
    af=p.nut_af+p.socket_af_clearance
    r=af/math.sqrt(3)
    vertices=[(r*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),r*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).polyline(vertices).close().extrude(h-p.floor_t+p.cut_overrun))
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_d_clearance)/2).extrude(h+p.cut_overrun))
    x=af/2
    z0=p.finger_root_z
    cut_h=h-z0+p.cut_overrun
    for i in range(int(p.finger_count)):
        angle=i*360/p.finger_count
        back=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.finger_back_gap,p.finger_width+2*p.finger_side_gap,cut_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((x+p.finger_t,0,z0))
        body=body.cut(back.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
        for sign in (-1,1):
            side=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.cut_overrun+p.finger_t+p.finger_back_gap,p.finger_side_gap,cut_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((x-p.cut_overrun,sign*(p.finger_width+p.finger_side_gap)/2,z0))
            body=body.cut(side.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    lip_z=p.floor_t+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_clearance
    profile=[(x+p.lip_union_overlap,lip_z),(x-p.lip_projection,lip_z),(x-p.lip_projection,lip_z+p.lip_vertical_land),(x,p.lip_top_z),(x+p.lip_union_overlap,p.lip_top_z)]
    for i in range(int(p.finger_count)):
        lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.finger_width).translate((0,p.finger_width/2,0))
        body=body.union(lip.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),i*360/p.finger_count))
    return body
","print_orientation":"Flat bottom on bed at z=0; pocket upward. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut enters from +Z. Bolt runs along Z and may enter from either side."},{"id":"socket_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"import math

def build(p):
    h=p.height
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(h)
    af=p.nut_af+p.socket_af_clearance
    r=af/math.sqrt(3)
    vertices=[(r*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),r*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_t).polyline(vertices).close().extrude(h-p.floor_t+p.cut_overrun))
    body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_d_clearance)/2).extrude(h+p.cut_overrun))
    x=af/2
    z0=p.finger_root_z
    cut_h=h-z0+p.cut_overrun
    for i in range(int(p.finger_count)):
        angle=i*360/p.finger_count
        back=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.finger_back_gap,p.finger_width+2*p.finger_side_gap,cut_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((x+p.finger_t,0,z0))
        body=body.cut(back.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
        for sign in (-1,1):
            side=cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.cut_overrun+p.finger_t+p.finger_back_gap,p.finger_side_gap,cut_h,centered=(False,True,False)).translate((x-p.cut_overrun,sign*(p.finger_width+p.finger_side_gap)/2,z0))
            body=body.cut(side.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),angle))
    lip_z=p.floor_t+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_clearance
    profile=[(x+p.lip_union_overlap,lip_z),(x-p.lip_projection,lip_z),(x-p.lip_projection,lip_z+p.lip_vertical_land),(x,p.lip_top_z),(x+p.lip_union_overlap,p.lip_top_z)]
    for i in range(int(p.finger_count)):
        lip=cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.finger_width).translate((0,p.finger_width/2,0))
        body=body.union(lip.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),i*360/p.finger_count))
    return body

Keep spring gaps empty. Use identical settings for knob. Coupon is a test only, not part of assembly.","parts":["socket_coupon","knob"]},{"n":"2","text":"Cool the print fully. Remove loose strings without cutting tabs or enlarging the pocket. Verify tabs are not fused to surrounding walls.","parts":["socket_coupon","knob"]},{"n":"3","text":"For the coupon test, align nut flats and press straight down with your thumb until seated on the shoulder and all three lips spring back above it. Do not hammer or use a bolt to pull it in. Check upside-down retention and free threading with your intended M5 bolt. Stop if insertion requires excessive force or a tab cracks or whitens.","parts":["socket_coupon"],"hardware":["captive_nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"If fit fails, do not force assembly. A further fit revision needs to know whether insertion is too tight or retention is too loose. If you used the coupon, recover the nut by carefully cutting away its sacrificial walls and tabs with side cutters; wear eye protection and keep fingers clear. Do not force nut through bottom hole.","parts":["socket_coupon"],"hardware":["captive_nut"],"tool":"Side cutters and eye protection, only if recovering nut from coupon"},{"n":"5","text":"Print knob after fit testing. Press the nut in by hand as above. Confirm all three lips return, the nut is entirely below the top surface, and it stays captive upside down. No glue or additional assembly hardware is required.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["captive_nut"]},{"n":"6","text":"Thread your M5 bolt through the captive nut from either side. Tighten using the knob by hand only; do not add torque using pliers. Hex flats transmit torque and tabs retain the nut during handling. Avoid high heat and replace if cracked. Not a rated or safety-critical fastener.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["captive_nut"]}],"questions":[{"text":"Can you measure nut across flats and thickness?","answer":"Cannot measure; use best judgment."},{"text":"Did either prior print accept and retain the nut?","answer":"No usable fit result supplied for either print."}]}
